svg.title: licenseal: catch incompatible dependency licenses before they block a release
svg.desc: A pixel-art meadow in a wooden frame. Down a path on the right, the duck in a hard hat checks the crates beside it with its checklist: one crate carries a green seal, the next an amber warning sign, and a shut gate stands before the release flag. The duck thinks of the licenseal wordmark, the line "Catch incompatible dependency licenses before they block a release", and "10 ecosystems, no dependency installs", by shcherbak_ai.
